outcome: intraoperative packed red blood cells (PRBCs) transfusion
cohort: The study included 20 pregnant women diagnosed with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) who underwent lower uterine segmentectomy.
finding: Lower uterine segmentectomy was found to be an effective technique for uterine preservation in PAS cases, with no reported cases of hemorrhage or surgical failure requiring hysterectomy.
